create_decoder_config_viterbi: create a DecoderConfig dataclass instance with the default viterbi decoder type
create_decoder_config_kenlm: create a DecoderConfig dataclass instance with the kenlm decoder type for language model decoding
create_flashlight_decoder_config: create a FlashlightDecoderConfig instance with beam search parameters and a KenLM language model path
configure_flashlight_decoder_beam: configure a FlashlightDecoderConfig with custom beam size, beam threshold, and word score values
review_decoder_config_classes: review the DecoderConfig and FlashlightDecoderConfig dataclasses to understand ASR decoder configuration options
